Goals: In the beginning I expect to see some pounds drop off, but that isn't my primary focus. Inches, strength and endurance are.

I'm using MFP to track everything I eat and want to stay below 1250 calories a day. Without any exercise at all my TDEE calculates at about 1600, which is only a deficit of 350 calories a day. EXCEPT I know from my previous calorie counting I actually average more like 1100 calories a day, I feel better setting the upper limit so if I do have a bad day it's ok and when I have a good day I get to be happy. It might not work for everyone but it works better for me. I end up averaging a weekly deficit of 3500, or one pound which was consistent with my weight loss over time.

I'm joining a gym next week and my goal is to go at least 5 times a week. Even if I just go use a treadmill or bike for 30+ minutes half the time or more, I think once I get there I will be better about staying longer.

Why next week and not today? Well for one thing I move this weekend, and for another the new month starts Tuesday. This week might not be great because I'm trying to use up all the food in the house before the move so eating what's available instead of what's best.

This has gotten pretty rambling but...ah well. Here goes nothing Internet strangers! Time to really turn things around.
